cluster_inventory.level: Global cell-type clustering (integrated background liver, tumor, PDX)
cluster_inventory.object: All cells (67,111 after QC; three HB tumors, two background livers, two PDX tumors)
cluster_inventory.tissue_condition: Human hepatoblastoma background liver, tumor, and PDX (HB17, HB30, HB53)
cluster_inventory.source: Results: 'Clustering was done, and eleven distinct cell types were classified (Fig. 3a)'; Fig.3a
cluster_inventory.note: Cell classes include hepatocytes, endothelial cells, hepatic stellate cells, Kupffer cells, immune cells, NK/T cells, cholangiocytes, erythrocytes, proliferative hepatocytes, and tumor cells.

cluster_inventory.level: Tumor cell subclustering (reclustering of annotated tumor cells)
cluster_inventory.object: 52,629 tumor cells from five HB tumor/PDX samples
cluster_inventory.tissue_condition: HB tumor and PDX samples (HB17 tumor, HB17 PDX, HB30 tumor, HB30 PDX, HB53 tumor)
cluster_inventory.source: Results: 'we reclustered the 52,629 tumor cells in HB tumor and PDX and identified 12 distinct clusters (Fig.5a)'; Fig.5a
cluster_inventory.note: Clusters Tr0–Tr11; Tr1/Tr4 have low UMIs/detected genes; Tr10 has a neuronal gene expression signature; five phenotypes described.
